name: CMA Do Not Mail Service

steps: Open the CMA Do Not Mail registration form, linked from the CMA consumer page.
Enter the name and mailing address exactly as marketers use them.
optout.notes: Free for consumers. CMA members that send direct mail must screen against this list. It covers personally addressed marketing mail only, not non-members and not a company's own customer lists. The CMA does not own or rent consumer lists. A French form is at https://cmadnm.cawebhosting.ca/submit_fr.asp.

sources.attribution: Canadian Marketing Association, Do Not Mail Service

verification_note: CMA consumer page and the linked registration form loaded with HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21. The page describes the free service and who must use it.
